#!/bin/sh
# Test for .factory/hooks/log-tool-call.sh: a PreToolUse payload writes a start record and the
# matching PostToolUse record carries ts_ms and duration_ms (end minus start). The payloads carry no
# tool_use_id (Droid 0.247.x), so the hook matches on session, tool and tool_input.

hook="$root/.factory/hooks/log-tool-call.sh"
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
failures=0

fail() {
  echo "FAIL: $1"
  failures=$((failures + 1))
}

# fire <now_ms> <event> <tool> <tool_input json> [session]
fire() {
  now=$1 event=$2 tool=$3 input=$4 session=${5:-sess-a}
  payload=$(jq -nc --arg e "$event" --arg t "$tool" --arg s "$session" --argjson i "$input" \
    '{session_id: $s, cwd: "/tmp", hook_event_name: $e, tool_name: $t, tool_input: $i}
     + (if $e == "PostToolUse" then {tool_response: {exitCode: 0}} else {} end)')
  printf '%s' "$payload" | FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR="$tmp" LOG_TOOL_CALL_NOW_MS="$now" sh "$hook"
  rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "hook exit $rc for $event $tool"
}

last() { log "${1:-sess-a}" | tail -1; }
expect() { # expect <label> <jq expr on last line> <expected>
  got=$(last | jq -r "$2")
  [ "$got" = "$3" ] || fail "$1: $2 = $got, expected $3"
}

#!/bin/sh
# Factory Pre/PostToolUse hook: append one compact JSON line per tool event to build-log/
# (ai/RULES.md rule 17, D-021, D-027). Records what was called, never the tool response, so the
# log stays small and cannot leak tool output.
#
# The payload has no tool_use_id (Droid 0.247.x: cwd, hook_event_name, permission_mode, session_id,
# tool_input, tool_name, tool_response, transcript_path), so `call_id` is a hash of tool name and
# tool input. A PostToolUse record pairs with the latest PreToolUse record of the same session and
# `call_id` that no later PostToolUse has claimed; `duration_ms` is null when there is none (a
# nested Execute inside a Script call logs a start and never an end, so such starts are skipped
# by the "latest unclaimed" rule). Two identical calls running in parallel pair imperfectly.
# LOG_TOOL_CALL_NOW_MS pins the clock for scripts/tests/log-tool-call-duration.sh.
set -u
input=$(cat)
root=${FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR:-$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd')}
day=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
dir="$root/build-log/$day"
mkdir -p "$dir"
session=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"')
file="$dir/$session.jsonl"

now_ms() {
  ns=$(date -u +%s%N)
  case "$ns" in
    *[!0-9]*) echo $(($(date -u +%s) * 1000)) ;; # date without %N
    *) echo $((ns / 1000000)) ;;
  esac
}
sha() { shasum -a 256 2>/dev/null || sha256sum; }

ms=${LOG_TOOL_CALL_NOW_MS:-$(now_ms)}
event=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.hook_event_name // ""')
call_id=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -cS '[.tool_name, .tool_input]' | sha | cut -c1-16)

duration=null
if [ "$event" = PostToolUse ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then
  duration=$(grep -F "\"call_id\":\"$call_id\"" "$file" | jq -s --argjson now "$ms" '
    (map(.event == "PreToolUse") | rindex(true)) as $pre
    | (map(.event == "PostToolUse") | rindex(true)) as $post
    | if $pre != null and ($post == null or $pre > $post) then $now - .[$pre].ts_ms else null end
  ' 2>/dev/null) || duration=null
  [ -n "$duration" ] || duration=null
fi

# `?` keeps jq from failing when tool_input or tool_response is a string or an array
# (Droid 0.247.0 sends tool_response as a string or an array); append only on success so a
# jq error cannot leave an empty file behind. The first nine fields are D-021's; new ones go last.
line=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -c --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
  --arg id "$call_id" --argjson ms "$ms" --argjson dur "$duration" '{
  ts: $ts,
  session_id: .session_id,
  event: .hook_event_name,
  tool: .tool_name,
  command: (.tool_input.command? // null),
  file: (.tool_input.file_path? // null),
  summary: (.tool_input.summary? // null),
  script: (.tool_input.script? // null | if . == null then null else .[0:200] end),
  exit_code: (.tool_response.exitCode? // null),
  call_id: $id,
  ts_ms: $ms
} + (if .hook_event_name == "PostToolUse" then {duration_ms: $dur} else {} end)') && [ -n "$line" ] && printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$file"
exit 0
EOF
cd /Users/dct/code/EllyaOrg/projects/dalimaray/observatory-wt/m1 && sh scripts/tests/log-tool-call-duration.sh; echo exit=$?; shellcheck .factory/hooks/log-tool-call.sh; echo sc=$?

#!/bin/sh
# Compile time and its share of a wall-clock window, from the build-log written by
# .factory/hooks/log-tool-call.sh (D-021, D-027). Usage:
#   scripts/compile-share.sh <build-log dir> <from-ts> <to-ts>
# Timestamps are UTC, as in the log's `ts` field: 2026-10-23T10:00:00Z.
#
# Sums duration_ms of PostToolUse records in the window whose `command` has a segment (after the
# start or after ; & | and an optional `cd x &&`) that begins with `cargo `, `cargo-tauri`,
# `make check`, `make test` or `trunk `. Sessions that ran at the same time overlap, so the sum can
# exceed the window; the share is then of the window, as measured. A call made inside a Script
# call logs no end record of its own (only the whole Script call is timed), so those are reported
# on a second line and left out of the sum.
set -eu
if [ "$#" -ne 3 ]; then
  echo "usage: $0 <build-log dir> <from-ts> <to-ts>" >&2
  exit 2
fi
dir=$1 from=$2 to=$3
[ -d "$dir" ] || { echo "compile-share: no such directory: $dir" >&2; exit 2; }

files=$(find "$dir" -name '*.jsonl' -type f | sort)
[ -n "$files" ] || { echo "compile-share: no .jsonl files under $dir" >&2; exit 2; }

# shellcheck disable=SC2086
result=$(cat $files | jq -rs --arg from "$from" --arg to "$to" '
  def wall: (($to | fromdateiso8601) - ($from | fromdateiso8601));
  def seg: "(^|[;&|(])\\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=\\S*\\s+)*";
  def compile: test(seg + "(cargo |cargo-tauri|make (check|test)($|[\\s;&|>])|trunk )");
  if wall <= 0 then error("window end must be after start") else . end
  | [.[] | select(.event == "PostToolUse" and .ts >= $from and .ts <= $to)] as $win
  | [$win[] | select(.tool != "Script" and ((.command // "") | compile))] as $c
  | [$win[] | select(.tool == "Script" and ((.script // "") | test("cargo |cargo-tauri|make (check|test)|trunk ")))] as $s
  | [ ($c | map(.duration_ms // 0) | add // 0),
      wall,
      ($c | map(select(.duration_ms != null)) | length),
      ($c | map(select(.duration_ms == null)) | length),
      ($s | length),
      ($s | map(.duration_ms // 0) | add // 0) ] | @tsv') || exit 2

printf '%s\n' "$result" | awk -F '\t' '{
  printf "compile_seconds=%.3f wall_seconds=%d share=%.1f%% calls=%d calls_without_duration=%d\n",
    $1 / 1000, $2, $1 / 1000 / $2 * 100, $3, $4
  printf "script_calls_mentioning_compile=%d script_seconds=%.3f (not in the sum)\n", $5, $6 / 1000
}'
EOF
